# PEC E-Summit 2026 — Comprehensive Reference

Organized by the Entrepreneurship & Incubation Cell (EIC), Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh.
Website: https://esummit.pec.ac.in
Dates: November 14–15, 2026
Location: Punjab Engineering College (PEC), Sector 12, Chandigarh, 160012, India.

---

## 1. About Punjab Engineering College (PEC) & EIC
Punjab Engineering College (Deemed to be University), founded in 1921, is one of India's oldest and most prestigious engineering institutions. Its alumni include pioneer astronaut Kalpana Chawla and numerous startup founders and industry captains.
The Entrepreneurship & Incubation Cell (EIC) is PEC's student-run body fostering venture creation, incubation, and early-stage startup enablement in the Chandigarh Tricity region and North India.

---

## 2. Event Tracks & Competitions
- **High-Stakes Pitch Competition**: Founders pitch pre-revenue and seed-stage startups to active angel networks and venture funds. 5-minute pitch followed by 5-minute Q&A. Top teams receive cash awards and direct mentorship.
- **36-Hour Hackathon**: Open software and hardware hackathon. Themes encompass AI for Bharat, FinTech, Climate Tech, and Deep Tech.
- **Startup Expo**: Showcase pavilion featuring 50+ emerging ventures demonstrating products to delegates, mentors, and investors.
- **Leadership Panels**: Keynote debates covering fundraising in tough markets, AI adoption, hardware incubation, and student entrepreneurship playbooks.

---

## 3. Ticketing & Registration
- Delegate Pass: Free for students with verified college credentials.
- Hackathon Pass: Dedicated access for hackathon participants.
- All-Access Pass: VIP seating, masterclasses, and access to select networking mixers.
- Startup Packages (Silver, Gold, Diamond): Tiered access including expo stalls, pitch slots, and private investor meetings. Applications are submitted via https://esummit.pec.ac.in/passes and reviewed by the organizing committee.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- Q: Who can attend E-Summit 2026?
  A: Open to all college students, researchers, early-stage founders, angel investors, and tech professionals across India.
- Q: Where is the venue?
  A: Main auditorium and campus grounds of Punjab Engineering College (PEC), Sector 12, Chandigarh.
- Q: Is accommodation available?
  A: Limited hostel and partner accommodation is facilitated for outstation participants registered for multi-day tracks.
- Q: How to pitch to investors?
  A: Apply through the Passes portal for the Funding Conclave / Startup pass tiers with pitch deck and venture metrics.
